verdict.rationale: Reflect's import/export docs say you can always export your notes to an open format such as HTML or Markdown, and the founder repeats on HN that notes export to markdown or HTML so users shouldn't feel locked in. The API cannot serve note contents because of end-to-end encryption, so export depends on the in-app feature. Missing for 10: detail on what an export covers (attachments/images, backlinks, note history), a programmatic or automated bulk-export path, and independent hands-on confirmation that a full export works.
